name: Bitwise
description: Bitwise is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Bitwise Asset Management is a privately held asset manager specializing in crypto assets. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $70 million equity round announced on February 25, 2025, was completed without a disclosed valuation; the last valuation the company published, with its Series B in June 2021, was more than $500 million.

Founded in 2017 and based in San Francisco, Bitwise manages exchange-traded funds and other investment products that hold crypto assets. Those funds trade under their own tickers and are separate from the company's own shares. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company. Bitwise did not disclose a valuation for its 2019 or 2025 financings.
round_notes: Bitwise said the proceeds of the 2025 financing would strengthen its balance sheet and expand its investment capabilities. In February 2025, the company reported more than $12 billion in client assets; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Electric Capital led the 2025 financing, with participation from MassMutual, Haun Ventures, MIT Investment Management Company, General Catalyst, Khosla Ventures, ParaFi Capital, Highland Capital and Blockchain Coinvestors. Elad Gil and Electric Capital led the Series B, and Highlight Capital Partners led the Series A. Other investors include Third Point, Coinbase Ventures, Blockchain Capital and Castle Island Ventures.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Bitwise appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Bitwise's announcements of its 2025 financing and Series B; reports by The Block (February 2025), CNBC (June 2021), CoinDesk (June 2021) and Blockworks (June 2021); and SEC Form D filings.
